show: What We Do in the Shadows
shortName: What We Do in the Shadows
seoTitle: What We Do in the Shadows Test: Which Character Are You? (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the What We Do in the Shadows test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Nandor, Laszlo, Nadja, Colin Robinson, Guillermo or the Guide — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the self-proclaimed leader, the energy vampire, or the one who actually does all the work? Answer 10 everyday questions about housemates, work and parties, and find out which What We Do in the Shadows character you are.

characters.name: Nandor the Relentless
characters.title: The Self-Proclaimed Leader
characters.summary: Grand, dramatic and secretly soft. You're in charge, at least in your own head, and the modern world baffles you.
description: Like Nandor, you've got a big past. He's a 760-year-old former warrior from the kingdom of Al-Quolanudar who fought for the Ottoman Empire.
You think you're the boss. Nandor calls himself the leader of the house, though nobody really does what he says.
You're softer than you look. Nandor is baffled by modern life, and he cares deeply about Guillermo, even if he can't say so.
characters.flaw: You act like you're in charge, then ask someone else what to do.
characters.signature: A grand title, a dramatic sigh and no idea how the TV remote works.
characters.clashReason: they'd announce they were in charge, then ask you how everything works

characters.name: Laszlo Cravensworth
characters.title: The Eccentric Gentleman
characters.summary: Posh, flirtatious and wonderfully odd. You've got strange hobbies, and you commit to them completely.
description: Like Laszlo, you have refined tastes, of a sort. He's a 310-year-old vampire from the British nobility, married to Nadja.
You're a hobbyist at heart. Laszlo carries out bizarre scientific experiments and shapes the hedges in the garden into topiary.
You commit to a disguise. On the run from another vampire, Laszlo put on jeans, stuck a toothpick in his mouth and became Jackie Daytona, a bar owner in Pennsylvania.
characters.flaw: You get so absorbed in your own projects that you forget everyone else.
characters.signature: A pair of hedge clippers, a lab full of experiments and a toothpick for emergencies.
characters.clashReason: they'd vanish into their latest strange project just when you needed them

characters.name: Nadja
characters.title: The Fierce One
characters.summary: Bold, blunt and nobody's fool. You've got no patience for nonsense, especially from the men in your life.
description: Like Nadja, you've been around. She's a 500-year-old vampire from Antipaxos in Greece, and she's the one who turned Laszlo into a vampire.
You don't hold back. Nadja is abrasive and aggressive, and she's constantly fed up with her male housemates.
You've got big ambitions. Nadja is nostalgic for her human life, and she goes on to run her own vampire nightclub. There's even a doll that looks just like her.
characters.flaw: You hold a grudge longer than anyone thought possible.
characters.signature: A sharp tongue, a long memory and a doll that looks a lot like you.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what's wrong with you, and never let it go

characters.name: Colin Robinson
characters.title: The Energy Vampire
characters.summary: Polite, chatty and absolutely draining. You can bore anyone into submission, and you enjoy it.
description: Like Colin Robinson, you have a rare gift. He's an energy vampire who feeds on people's boredom and frustration.
You fit right in at the office. Colin is a day walker with a normal office job, and he pays for a lot of the household's bills.
You can talk about anything for hours. Colin's favourite way to feed is to keep people talking, or listening, until they're completely exhausted.
characters.flaw: You keep talking long after everyone else has stopped listening.
characters.signature: A desk job, a very long story and a coworker slowly losing the will to live.
characters.clashReason: they'd explain something to you in so much detail that you'd want to cry

characters.name: Guillermo
characters.title: The Overlooked Hero
characters.summary: Hard-working, capable and badly underappreciated. You hold the whole place together, and nobody says thank you.
description: Like Guillermo, you put in the work. He has been Nandor's familiar for more than ten years, doing everything for him in the hope of one day becoming a vampire.
You're more dangerous than you look. Guillermo turns out to be a descendant of Van Helsing, and he's a very skilled vampire slayer.
You protect the people you love. Guillermo ends up as the household's bodyguard, even though he's the only human living there.
characters.flaw: You wait far too long for other people to notice what you're worth.
characters.signature: A to-do list, a hidden wooden stake and a lot of quiet patience.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly do your job better than you, and never mention it

characters.name: The Guide
characters.title: The Hopeful Outsider
characters.summary: Eager, polite and desperate to be included. You'd do anything to be part of the group.
description: Like the Guide, you know the rules. She's an envoy from the Vampiric Council, and she takes her official role very seriously.
You just want to be invited. The Guide keeps trying to win the other vampires over, and they keep leaving her out.
You've got a few tricks of your own. The Guide can teleport short distances, and eventually ends up working for Nadja.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to fit in that people notice how hard you're trying.
characters.signature: A rule book, a hopeful smile and an invitation that never arrives.
characters.clashReason: they'd invite themselves along to everything you do

questions.text: Your housemates have left all the chores to you, again. You...

options.text: Do them quietly, and wait for someone to notice
Put yourself in charge of a chore rota, then do none of it
Tell them, very loudly, that you are not their servant
Do something more interesting instead, like the garden

questions.text: A coworker asks how your weekend was. You...

options.text: Tell them. In great detail. For forty minutes
Say it was splendid, and give no details whatsoever
Ask about theirs, hoping they'll invite you next time
Say 'fine' and get back to work. There's a lot to do
A long bath, and remembering the good old days
Working on a strange experiment in the shed, alone
Watching a film you've seen twenty times, and still getting confused
Reading the full terms and conditions of everything you own

questions.text: You're passed over for something you really wanted. You...

options.text: Keep working hard. One day they'll see what you can do
Turn up anyway, and act as if you were invited
Give a dramatic speech about everything you've done for them
Start your own version. You'll do it better

questions.text: Someone at a party is being incredibly boring. You...

options.text: Out-bore them. You're much better at it
Walk away in the middle of their sentence
Listen politely, because nobody else will
Agree with everything they say, in case they like you

questions.text: You need to talk your way out of trouble. You...

options.text: Put on a disguise and commit to being someone else entirely
Accidentally tell the truth within a minute
Blame the paperwork. It's always the paperwork
Handle it yourself. You're far more capable than anyone realises

questions.text: Someone you love forgets something important. You...

options.text: Never, ever let them forget it
Get very upset, then forgive them by dinner
Remind them politely, then sort it out yourself
Don't notice. You forgot too

questions.text: A brand-new gadget comes out, and everyone's talking about it. You...

options.text: Have no idea how it works, and ask someone to set it up for you
Buy it, then be very annoying about how it's better than everyone else's
Ignore it. The old ways are better
Get one straight away, so you have something to talk about with people

questions.text: You're a vampire who has shared the same house with the same housemates for centuries. You...

options.text: Still insist that you're the leader
Bicker with your partner every night, and love every minute
Keep a careful record of what everyone's up to, for the Council
Drain them a little whenever they get too lively

questions.text: You're a vampire, and a human has just discovered your secret. You...

options.text: Charm them until they're not sure what they saw
Threaten them, very convincingly
Explain your entire history until they beg to leave
Report it to the vampire authorities, with all the right forms
